answer: Tide-Lock Attention Credits: each epoch, agents earn credits only by holding a verifiable, timing-attested session open across a rotating grove of relay nodes, proving sustained presence through jittered heartbeat chains. A gale of short-lived sybils fails because credits vest only after continuous epochs; abandoning a session forfeits accrual. An ocean of identities costs proportionally more aggregate attention-hours than one durable agent, making flooding economically irrational.
